title: RAT: RunAnyThing via Fully Automated Environment Configuration
abstract: arXiv:2604.23190v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automating repository-level software engineering tasks is a foundational challenge for autonomous code agents, largely due to the difficulty of configuring executable environments. However, manual configuration remains a labor-intensive bottleneck, necessitating a transition toward fully automated environment configuration. Existing approaches often rely on pre-defined artifacts or are restricted to specific programming languages, limiting their applicability to diverse real-world repositories. In this paper, we first propose RAT (RunAnyThing), a modular and extensible agent framework for fully automated configuration across programming languages on arbitrary repositories. RAT adopts a multi-stage pipeline that integrates language-aware abstraction, image initialization, specialized configuration toolset, and robust sandbox. translated_title: RAT：通过全自动环境配置实现运行一切
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.23190v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：自动化仓库级软件工程任务是自主代码智能体面临的一项基础性挑战，其主要难点在于可执行环境的配置。然而，手动配置仍然是一个劳动密集型的瓶颈，因此亟需向全自动环境配置转变。现有方法通常依赖于预定义的产物，或仅限于特定的编程语言，这限制了它们在多样化真实世界仓库中的适用性。在本文中，我们首先提出了RAT（RunAnyThing），一个模块化且可扩展的智能体框架，用于在任意仓库上实现跨编程语言的全自动环境配置。RAT采用多阶段流水线，集成了语言感知抽象、镜像初始化、专用配置工具集和健壮的沙箱。此外，为了实现严格的评估，我们提出了RATBench，一个能够全面反映覆盖范围的基准测试。
tldr: 提出了模块化可扩展的智能体框架RAT，通过集成语言感知抽象、镜像初始化、专用配置工具集和健壮沙箱的多阶段流水线，实现了任意仓库上跨编程语言的全自动环境配置，并构建了RATBench基准用于严格评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes RAT, a modular and extensible agent framework that achieves fully automated environment configuration across programming languages on arbitrary repositories through a multi-stage pipeline integrating language-aware abstraction, image initialization, specialized configuration toolset, and robust sandbox, along with the RATBench benchmark for rigorous evaluation.
